title: [Chapitre] VIII. Analysis situs (quatrième mouture) : notes manuscrites (26/06-04/07/1986).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting (from neighbouring pages): this is Grothendieck's combinatorial, 'tame' model of one-dimensional analysis situs.
- L is a totally ordered set of 'points' sitting inside a larger ordered set M (for example points in a line).
- A finite flag Δ ⊂ L, an element of Dvep*(L) or Drap(L), cuts M into 'intertypic' intervals between consecutive points of Δ.
- A (pre)figure Φ is a finite cell complex made of 0-cells Φ_0 (points of Δ) and 1-cells Φ_1 (intervals of Δ). Its geometric realization is a finite union of points and open intervals, i.e. a definable subset of a line.
- The previous page decomposes Δ = δΦ into pieces: Δ_is (isolated points), Δ_red (redundant points, interior to a component and kept), Δ_loc (punctures, interior to a component and removed), ∂_0 (endpoints belonging to Φ) and ∂'_0 (endpoints not belonging to Φ). Here Ψ = (Ψ_1,...,Ψ_n) are the connected components of the 1-cells, encoded by a_1<b_1<...<a_n<b_n.
- An irredundant prefigure (Δ_red = ∅) is equivalent to the data Ψ, ∂_0 ⊂ ∂Ψ ⊂ Δ.

Corollary 2 ('pour mémoire', assuming Φ irredundant): the realization s-pr°(Φ), apparently also Omb°(Φ), is the disjoint union of the open shadow Omb°(Φ_1) (union of the open 1-cells) and the 0-cells.

Corollary 3 constructs the complementary figure Φ'^*:
- its 1-cells are the intertypic intervals of Δ not in Φ_1;
- its 0-cells are Φ'^*_0 = δΦ \ Φ_0 = Δ \ Φ_0 = Δ_loc ⊔ ∂'_0, where ∂'_0 := ∂Φ \ ∂_0Φ = ∂Ψ \ ∂_0.

A marginal 'Rappel' records the bookkeeping: Δ = Δ_is ⊔ Δ_int ⊔ ∂Ψ, Φ_0 = Δ_is ⊔ Δ_red ⊔ ∂_0, Δ_int = Δ_red ⊔ Δ_loc, ∂Ψ = ∂_0 ⊔ ∂'_0.

Grothendieck then judges this presentation 'franchement compliqué' and restarts more simply. A prefigure is the triple:
1. Δ = δΦ (a flag in L);
2. Φ_1 ⊂ (Φ_Δ)_1, the set of intertypic intervals of Δ;
3. Φ_0 ⊂ (Φ_Δ)_0 = Δ.

The next page adds the purity condition that every s ∈ Δ \ Φ_0 is an endpoint of some X ∈ Φ_1. It defines the complement simply as (Φ_Δ)_i \ Φ_i, and computes the complement of the realization in M as Omb°(Φ'^*_1) ⊔ M_{<a} ⊔ M_{>b}.

Purpose: to set up the Boolean algebra (complements) of tame subsets of a 1-dimensional ordered space, as the base case of a combinatorial, stratified 'analysis situs' (tame topology programme of the Esquisse).
errors: No mathematical error found. The identity Δ \ Φ_0 = Δ_loc ⊔ ∂'_0 follows correctly from the two decompositions in the margin.

Corollary 2 as transcribed (Omb°(Φ_1) ∪ Δ_is Φ_0) would omit the closed endpoints ∂_0 unless the struck 'Δ_is' leaves simply '∪ Φ_0'. The intended formula is presumably realization = Omb°(Φ_1) ⊔ Φ_0, which is correct for irredundant Φ.
The first presentation of Φ'^* in the figure is only half-written and is abandoned by the author himself in favour of the cleaner (Δ, Φ_1, Φ_0) description.

ideas.what: Encoding finite unions of points and open intervals in an ordered line by a flag Δ plus chosen 0-cells and 1-cells (prefigures/figures), with a redundancy notion and a canonical irredundant form
ideas.modern_name: cell decomposition of definable subsets in dimension 1 (o-minimal cell decomposition, n=1); canonical minimal stratification of a semilinear subset of R
ideas.where_published: Only the programme of a 'topologie modérée' is in Esquisse d'un programme (1984); this combinatorial development is unpublished

ideas.what: Complementary figure Φ'^* (complement of the cells inside the cell structure of Δ) and the formula for the complement of the realization
ideas.modern_name: closure of definable sets under complement / Boolean algebra of constructible subsets of a 1-dim stratified space

ideas.what: Decomposition Δ = Δ_is ⊔ Δ_red ⊔ Δ_loc ⊔ ∂_0 ⊔ ∂'_0 classifying vertices as isolated, redundant, punctures, closed ends and open ends
ideas.modern_name: local type of a point in a 1-dim stratified set (link types)

deep.surprise_reason: Careful but elementary bookkeeping for one-dimensional tame sets, contemporaneous with the birth of o-minimality. It has some historical interest as Grothendieck's own combinatorial approach to 'topologie modérée', but contains no new result or connection.
transcription_corrections: Corollary 2: the struck text before Φ_0 leaves most plausibly 's-pr°(Φ) = Omb°(Φ_1) ∪ Φ_0' (disjoint union), with 'Δ_is' struck rather than part of the formula.
Figure text reads approximately: 'des intervalles intertypiques de Δ qui ne sont pas dans Φ i.e. qui ... [pas] dans Omb(Ψ), et Φ'^*_0 = δΔ \ Φ_0 = ∂'_0'. 'intertypiques' replaces a struck 'figures'.
Margin: 'où Δ_int = Δ_red ⊔ Δ_loc' (the 'U' glyphs are Δ's), and '∂Ψ = ∂_0 ⊔ ∂'_0'.
Point 1° likely reads 'Δ = δΦ ∈ Drap^L(L)' or 'Dvep*(L)', consistent with the previous page's Dvep*(L); the uncertain reading remains.
Point 2°: '(Φ_Δ)_1 = ens. des intervalles intertypiques de Δ' – the reading 'intertypiques' is confirmed by the next page.
